name: ostranauts
title: Ostranauts
facts: A mod folder holds mod_info.json, a JSON list whose first object names the mod in strName and gives its version in strModVersion.
The cover is preview.png at the top of the uploaded folder.

What a phobos-ostranauts package must hold (BepInEx plugin folders, read-only data headers, sounds) is that project's policy, not a format fact: its wrapper passes it in as the project's payload hook.
